name: What are the Old and New Calendars?
about: Some Orthodox Churches, such as those of Russia, Serbia, Georgia and Jerusalem, keep the fixed feasts on the old Julian calendar, now 13 days behind, so their Christmas is on 7 January. Others, such as those of Constantinople, Greece, Antioch and Romania, keep them by the Revised Julian calendar, in step with the civil calendar. All keep Pascha on the same day. You can switch between them in Settings.
